tool.name: ML Particle Picker
tool.description: Fast ML-based particle detection and CTF estimation for CryoEM

configfiles.configfile: mount_points: #if $storage.use_external_storage #if $storage.nfs_path - type: nfs path: $storage.nfs_path #end if #if $storage.lustre_path - type: lustre path: $storage.lustre_path #end if #if $storage.beegfs_path - type: beegfs path: $storage.beegfs_path #end if #end if

tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/ml_picker.py' --input '$input_micrograph' --output '$output_coordinates' --particle_size $particle_size --confidence_threshold $confidence_threshold --device cpu --batch_size $batch_size #if $advanced.min_distance --min_distance $advanced.min_distance #end if #if $advanced.edge_exclusion --edge_exclusion $advanced.edge_exclusion #end if #if $ctf.enable_ctf_estimation --ctf_estimation --voltage $ctf.voltage --cs $ctf.cs --pixel_size $ctf.pixel_size #end if #if $visualization.output_heatmap --output_confidence_map '$output_heatmap' #if $visualization.use_plotly --use_plotly #end if #end if #if $visualization.output_statistics --output_statistics '$output_statistics' #end if #if $storage.use_external_storage --storage_config '$storage_config' #end if --verbose --log_file '$log_file'

param.name: particle_size
param.label: Particle diameter (pixels)
param.help: Approximate diameter of particles to detect

param.name: confidence_threshold
param.label: Confidence threshold
param.help: Minimum confidence score for particle detection (higher = fewer but more accurate picks)

param.name: batch_size
param.label: Batch size
param.help: Processing batch size (higher = faster but more memory)

param.name: min_distance
param.label: Minimum distance between particles
param.help: Leave empty to use particle_size as default

param.name: edge_exclusion
param.label: Edge exclusion distance (pixels)
param.help: Exclude particles within this distance from micrograph edges

param.name: enable_ctf_estimation
param.label: Enable CTF parameter estimation
param.help: Estimate Contrast Transfer Function parameters (defocus, astigmatism, resolution)

param.name: pixel_size
param.label: Pixel size (Angstroms/pixel)
param.help: Calibrated pixel size of the micrograph

param.name: output_heatmap
param.label: Generate confidence heatmap
param.help: Create visual heatmap showing detection confidence

param.name: output_statistics
param.label: Generate statistics plot
param.help: Create statistical visualization of detection results

param.name: use_external_storage
param.label: Use external storage mounts
param.help: Enable support for NFS, Lustre, or BeeGFS filesystems

param.name: lustre_path
param.label: Lustre mount path
param.help: Path to Lustre filesystem mount point

param.name: beegfs_path
param.label: BeeGFS mount path
param.help: Path to BeeGFS filesystem mount point

tool.help:
**What it does**
Fast ML-based particle picking and CTF estimation for CryoEM micrographs using a lightweight CNN.
**Key Features**
- Automated particle detection with confidence scoring - CTF parameter estimation (defocus, astigmatism, resolution) - Support for large datasets (<1TB) via external storage - Interactive visualizations with Plotly and Seaborn - Optimized for speed: 2-5 seconds per micrograph on GPU
**Inputs**
- **Micrograph**: CryoEM image in MRC format - **Particle diameter**: Approximate size of particles in pixels (50-1000) - **Confidence threshold**: Detection threshold (0.1-0.99) - Lower = more particles (higher recall, lower precision) - Higher = fewer particles (lower recall, higher precision)
**Outputs**
- **STAR file**: Particle coordinates and confidence scores in RELION/CryoSPARC format - **CTF parameters** (optional): Defocus, astigmatism, fit resolution, max resolution - **Confidence heatmap** (optional): Visual representation of detection confidence - **Statistics plot** (optional): Distribution and spatial analysis
**CTF Estimation**
When enabled, estimates:
- Defocus (U and V directions): 0.5-3.5 micrometers - Astigmatism: <500 Angstroms - CTF fit resolution: 4.5-6.0 Angstroms - Maximum resolution from Thon rings: 3.4-5.0 Angstroms
**Performance**
- Processing speed: 2-5 seconds per micrograph on GPU, 10-20 seconds on CPU - Memory usage: <1GB for most datasets - Scalable to ~200 million particles
**External Storage**
For datasets >1TB, configure external storage mounts:
- **NFS**: Network File System for shared storage - **Lustre**: Parallel distributed filesystem for HPC - **BeeGFS**: Parallel cluster filesystem
**Tips for Best Results**
1. Start with confidence threshold 0.7, adjust based on results 2. Use CTF estimation to assess image quality 3. Enable visualizations to review detection quality 4. For large datasets, configure external storage mounts 5. Adjust min_distance to prevent overlapping detections
**Workflow Integration**
This tool integrates seamlessly with downstream CryoEM processing:
1. Collect data → Upload to Galaxy 2. Run ML Particle Picker 3. Review results (heatmaps, statistics) 4. Adjust parameters if needed 5. Continue with 2D/3D classification
**Citations**
If you use this tool, please cite:
- ML Particle Picker: doi:10.1016/j.jsb.2023.107850 - RELION: doi:10.7554/eLife.18722 - CryoSPARC: doi:10.1038/nmeth.4169
